statement: On cejel's v27 B3 fourth pass (#640), a check admitted by its tool name credited forms that cannot fail or that run repository code: `ruff check -e`, `--fix`, `black .`, a requirements line naming a local archive, `npm test --prefix stub`, a make target make skips as up to date. The review found six such blockers after the pass had already replaced one refusal list with an allowlist of runners. Rule: for every credit path, read each argument and flag against a list of forms known to keep the exit code and to run only what the reader read, and read every place the environment or the target can be changed (the command's own line, the job's container and services, package-selecting flags, the build tool's own rules), not only the `env:` mappings.
